title: Caleb's Request

questions.question: How old was Caleb when Moses sent him to spy out the land?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:7 (ESV): "I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me..."

questions.question: How old was Caleb when he made his request to Joshua?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:10 (ESV): "And now, behold, I am this day eighty-five years old."

questions.question: What city did Caleb ask for?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:13 (ESV): "Then Joshua blessed him, and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance."

questions.question: Who inhabited the hill country Caleb asked for?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:12 (ESV): "...the Anakim were there with great fortified cities."

questions.question: Why was Hebron given to Caleb?
options: Because he wholly followed the Lord, the God of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Because he wholly followed the Lord, the God of Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:14 (ESV): "...because he wholly followed the Lord, the God of Israel."

questions.question: Who distributed the inheritances to the people of Israel?
options: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:1 (ESV): "...which Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses... distributed..."

questions.question: What method was used to distribute the inheritance?
What was the former name of Hebron?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:15 (ESV): "Now the name of Hebron formerly was Kiriath-arba..."

questions.question: Who was Arba?
options: The greatest man among the Anakim
questions.correctAnswer: The greatest man among the Anakim
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:15 (ESV): "...(Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim). And the land had rest from war."

questions.question: Caleb said his strength was what compared to when Moses sent him?
options: As my strength was then, so is my strength now
questions.correctAnswer: As my strength was then, so is my strength now
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:11 (ESV): "I am still as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me..."

questions.question: What happened to the report of the other spies?
options: They made the heart of the people melt
questions.correctAnswer: They made the heart of the people melt
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:8 (ESV): "But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt..."

questions.question: How many tribes received inheritance in the land of Canaan (west)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:2 (ESV): "...for the nine and one-half tribes."

questions.question: Of which tribe was Caleb?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 (ESV): "Then the people of Judah came to Joshua... and Caleb... said..."

questions.question: What was Caleb's father's name and title?
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:6 (ESV): "...Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite..."

questions.question: Where was Kadesh-barnea significant for Caleb?
options: It was where Moses sent him to spy out the land
It was where he was born
questions.correctAnswer: It was where Moses sent him to spy out the land
questions.explanation: Joshua 14:7 (ESV): "...Moses... sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land..."

key_verse_text: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel. (ESV)
